item.title: The Philippines: Smart Communications for Citizens in the Digital Age
item.description: DOLE-12 is actively strengthening smart communications and digital literacy initiatives to keep citizens well-informed and equip the workforce with the essential skills to thrive in a modern, tech-driven environment.

item.title: Hong Kong PolyU’s New Academy Advances Applied AI
item.description: The new AI Academy advances next-generation technologies and accelerates practical, secure applications across key sectors in Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area, supporting broader innovation efforts.

item.title: Singapore: TS2 Accelerates Innovative Social Impact Ventures
item.description: The TS2 Accelerator Programme in Singapore supports tech-driven social impact start-ups, empowering them to address mental health, education, senior care and economic mobility challenges while scaling globally.

item.title: Malaysia: Senawang Facility Boosts Semiconductor Manufacturing
item.description: A new Senawang facility expands Malaysia’s semiconductor equipment manufacturing, boosting tech capacity, skilled talent development and the nation’s position in global innovation supply chains.

item.title: The Philippines: Harnessing Tech for Climate-Resilient Agriculture
item.description: The Philippines is transforming agriculture by combining digital monitoring systems and climate-resilient practices to help farmers improve productivity, reduce risks and strengthen livelihoods.

item.title: Australia: University of Queensland Trials Robotic Exoskeleton Tech
item.description: UQ researchers are trialling a lightweight robotic exoskeleton that provides ankle assistance to help people with Motor Neurone Disease maintain mobility and independence.

item.title: India: A Strategic, Ethical and Transformative AI Vision
item.description: India is strategically leveraging AI to transform healthcare and scientific research while carefully monitoring its use in social media and the film industry to ensure responsible, ethical advancement.

item.title: HKUST Partners for Hong Kong’s First Hydrogen Innovation Hub
item.description: Hong Kong establishes a hydrogen innovation hub to advance production, storage and fuel-cell technologies, accelerating commercial deployment and supporting wider low-carbon energy goals.

item.title: Vietnam: National Digital Platform for Civil Judgment Enforcement
item.description: Vietnam has launched a nationwide digital platform and intelligent operations centre to streamline civil judgment enforcement, enhancing efficiency, transparency and citizen access.

item.title: Singapore: Tech-Enabled Approach to Future-Ready Healthcare
item.description: Singapore is leveraging technology, digital tools and innovative care models to transform eldercare and hospital development, significantly improving efficiency, quality, safety and overall patient outcomes.
